references.text: Deals with false prophets and how to recognize them, providing criteria for distinguishing between true and false prophets.
Jeremiah warns against false prophets who claim to have received dreams from God but speak lies in the Lord's name.
The Lord condemns prophets who prophesy lies and false visions and dreams.
Ezekiel speaks against false prophets who follow their own spirit and see false visions.
Jesus warns that false messiahs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect.
Jesus warns against false prophets who come in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
Paul writes about the coming of the lawless one with powerful deeds, lying signs and wonders.
The beast from the earth performs great signs and deceives the inhabitants of the earth with the signs it was given power to perform.
John urges testing the spirits to see if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
